sql: SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(p.posting_key) AS open_remote_evals_listings FROM fct_posting p JOIN dim_company c ON p.company_key = c.company_key JOIN posting_skills ps ON p.posting_key = ps.posting_key WHERE p.remote_us = TRUE AND p.is_open = TRUE AND ps.skill = 'evals' GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY open_remote_evals_listings DESC LIMIT 1
